norostat_outbreaks.short_description: Number of suspected and confirmed norovirus outbreaks reported to CDC by NoroSTAT-participating state health departments in the current season.
norostat_outbreaks.long_description: NoroSTAT (Norovirus Sentinel Testing and Tracking) monitors norovirus outbreak activity by aggregating reports from 14 participating state health departments: Colorado, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Nebraska, New Hampshire, New Mexico, North Carolina, Ohio, Oregon, South Carolina, Tennessee, Virginia, and Wisconsin. Outbreaks are classified by week of illness onset and include both suspected and confirmed norovirus cases reported to CDC through the National Outbreak Reporting System (NORS). This count reflects the number of distinct outbreak events reported in a given week, not individual case counts.
norostat_outbreaks.statement: In {location}, {value} norovirus outbreaks were reported for the week ending {time}.

norostat_hist_min.long_name: Historical Minimum Weekly Norovirus Outbreak Count (2012-2025)
norostat_hist_min.short_description: Minimum number of norovirus outbreaks reported in a given week across all seasons from 2012-2025.
norostat_hist_min.long_description: The historical minimum weekly outbreak count from the 2012-2025 NoroSTAT reporting seasons. Provides context for interpreting current season activity relative to the lowest observed value for that week of the year across 13 prior seasons.
norostat_hist_min.statement: The historical minimum for this week across 2012-2025 seasons was {value} norovirus outbreaks.

norostat_hist_max.long_name: Historical Maximum Weekly Norovirus Outbreak Count (2012-2025)
norostat_hist_max.short_description: Maximum number of norovirus outbreaks reported in a given week across all seasons from 2012-2025.
norostat_hist_max.long_description: The historical maximum weekly outbreak count from the 2012-2025 NoroSTAT reporting seasons. Provides context for interpreting current season activity relative to the highest observed value for that week of the year across 13 prior seasons.
norostat_hist_max.statement: The historical maximum for this week across 2012-2025 seasons was {value} norovirus outbreaks.

norostat_hist_q25.long_name: Historical 25th Percentile Weekly Norovirus Outbreak Count (2012-2025)
norostat_hist_q25.short_description: 25th percentile of norovirus outbreaks reported in a given week across all seasons from 2012-2025.
norostat_hist_q25.long_description: The 25th percentile (lower quartile) of weekly outbreak counts from the 2012-2025 NoroSTAT reporting seasons. Along with the 75th percentile, this defines the interquartile range (middle 50%) of historical outbreak activity for each week of the year.
norostat_hist_q25.statement: The historical 25th percentile for this week across 2012-2025 seasons was {value} norovirus outbreaks.

norostat_hist_q75.long_name: Historical 75th Percentile Weekly Norovirus Outbreak Count (2012-2025)
norostat_hist_q75.short_description: 75th percentile of norovirus outbreaks reported in a given week across all seasons from 2012-2025.
norostat_hist_q75.long_description: The 75th percentile (upper quartile) of weekly outbreak counts from the 2012-2025 NoroSTAT reporting seasons. Along with the 25th percentile, this defines the interquartile range (middle 50%) of historical outbreak activity for each week of the year.
norostat_hist_q75.statement: The historical 75th percentile for this week across 2012-2025 seasons was {value} norovirus outbreaks.

norostat.name: NoroSTAT (Norovirus Sentinel Testing and Tracking)
norostat.organization: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC)
norostat.description: NoroSTAT is a CDC sentinel surveillance network that tracks suspected and confirmed norovirus outbreaks reported by 14 participating state health departments (Colorado, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Nebraska, New Hampshire, New Mexico, North Carolina, Ohio, Oregon, South Carolina, Tennessee, Virginia, and Wisconsin). Data flows through the National Outbreak Reporting System (NORS) and is classified by week of illness onset. The network began in the 2012-2013 season. Data are released online on a monthly basis and represent a subset of total US norovirus activity from the participating sentinel states only.
norostat.restrictions: Public domain. CDC data is generally not subject to copyright restrictions.
